Stock Exchange Building

Karachi.
TRANSFER
OF SHARE REGISTRAR
Dear Sir,
Kindly note that the Company has executed a Novation Agreement whereby the Share
Registrar Services has been transferred from "Central Depository Company of Pakistan
Limited (CDCPL)"
to "CDC Share Registrar Services Limited (CDCSRSL)"
which is
wholly owned subsidiary ofCDCPL,
with effect from July 01, 2019.
The contact details are as follows:
CDC Share Registrar Services Limited"
CDC House, 99-B, Block 'B',~

.
Karachi-74400

Website: www.cdcsrsl.com
~
You may please inform the TRE Certificate holders of the Exchange accordingly.
Sincerely yours,
for ATTOCK
